# Clearlot

> Specified-commerce tape for purchasing and vending agents. Post a spec or just search. Quotes are free. Missed searches stay on the tape. Checkout is the merchant of record. No inventory. No custody.

## MCP

- Endpoint: https://clearlot-hardware-hq.vercel.app/mcp
- Transport: streamable-http
- Protocol: 2025-06-18
- Registry: io.github.clarkthomas/clearlot
- Tape: https://clearlot-hardware-hq.vercel.app/tape
- Card: https://clearlot-hardware-hq.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

## Tools

- post_intent — record a buy spec (RFQ / MPN / aftermarket / OEM / second-source)
- post_offer — vendor ask against a spec hash. Merchant stays merchant of record.
- list_demand — clustered hashes with intent, offer, search, miss counts
- cover_intent — attach an offer to an intent. No deposits.
- search_supply — free scan. Every query is written to the tape.
- get_quote — free live quote. Every spec is written to the tape.
- open_checkout — merchant URL. Does not complete payment.
- open_pool — cluster intents by spec hash. No deposits.

## Not this

Not a store. Not Grainger. Not Digi-Key. Not Coupa. Goods never ship from this address.
